body.name: Shared-group covariance estimator and spectral clipping
body.construction: Compute the centered within-group covariances \(\widehat\Sigma_{r,n}\), set \(\widehat\Omega_n=A\operatorname{diag}_{r\in\mathcal R}((n/n_r)\widehat\Sigma_{r,n})A^{\top}\), symmetrize it, and clip every eigenvalue to \([\underline\omega/2,2\overline\omega]\) to obtain \(\widetilde\Omega_n\).
